notes: Universe = stocks listed today (delisted stocks missing: survivorship bias, makes results look better).
No earnings filter (past earnings dates not available).
P is pessimistic: stop = day low (min 0.3 ATR), and any breakout day that closes below the entry counts as a full -1R loss.
H uses 60-minute bars: 60-min ORH entry, low-of-day stop at entry time.
Breakout volume in P uses the full day (unknown at entry); in H it is the pace up to the entry hour.
